parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.title,
  m.author_id,
  string_agg(
    c.title || E'\n\n' || c.content, 
    E'\n\n---\n\n' 
    ORDER BY c.chapter_number
  ) as full_content
FROM manuscripts m
JOIN chapters c ON c.manuscript_id = m.id
WHERE m.id = '{{ $json.body.manuscriptId }}'
GROUP BY m.id;

=INSERT INTO manuscript_versions (
  manuscript_id,
  phase_number,
  version_type,
  content,
  word_count,
  created_by_editor
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.manuscript_id }}',
  {{ $json.phase_number }},
  'approved_snapshot',
  '{{ $json.full_content.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.word_count }},
  '{{ $json.editor_name }}'
)
RETURNING id, manuscript_id, phase_number;

  }
}

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  ap.email,
  ap.first_name,
  ap.last_name,
  m.title as manuscript_title,
  m.id as manuscript_id
FROM manuscripts m
JOIN author_profiles ap ON m.author_id = ap.id
WHERE m.id = '{{ $("Webhook").first().json.body.manuscriptId }}';
